## Learning goals

Complete the exercises below using `fpp3`. Show plots and short written interpretations.

## Setup

```{r}
library(fpp3)
```


## 1. Manual vs automatic

```{r}
spain <- global_economy |> filter(Country == "Spain")
train <- spain |> filter(Year <= 2010)
fit <- train |>
  model(
    drift = RW(log(GDP) ~ drift()),
    auto = ARIMA(log(GDP) ~ PDQ(0,0,0)),
    ar110 = ARIMA(log(GDP) ~ pdq(1,1,0) + PDQ(0,0,0))
  )
glance(fit) |> arrange(AICc)
```

## 2. Forecast accuracy

```{r}
fit |> forecast(h = 8) |> accuracy(spain) |>
  select(.model, RMSE, MAE, MASE)
```

## 3. Residuals

```{r}
fit |> select(auto) |> gg_tsresiduals()
```
